/-- Event ids, room ids and room short ids are keys. -/
def Keys (s : Snapshot) : Prop :=
  (s.pdus.val.map (fun p => p.event_id.val)).Nodup ∧
  (s.rooms.val.map (fun r => r.id.val)).Nodup ∧
  (s.rooms.val.map (fun r => r.short.val)).Nodup

/-- [tuwunel_kernel::transition]:
    Source: 'src/lib.rs', lines 428:0-459:1
    Visibility: public -/
def transition
  (s : Snapshot) (req : Request) :
  Result (core.result.Result Reply Error)
  := do
  match req.op with
  | Op.Messages room «from» «to» dir limit filter =>
    api_message.get_message_events_route s req.user room «from» «to» dir
      limit filter
  | Op.Context room event limit filter =>
    api_context.get_context_route s req.user room event limit filter
  | Op.Relations room event rel_type event_type «from» «to» limit recurse
    dir =>
    api_relations.paginate_relations_with_filter s req.user room event
      event_type rel_type «from» «to» limit recurse dir
  | Op.Threads room «from» limit participated =>
    api_threads.get_threads_route s req.user room «from» limit participated
  | Op.State room => api_state.get_state_events_route s req.user room
  | Op.StateEvent room kind state_key =>
    api_state.get_state_events_for_key_route s req.user room kind state_key
  | Op.Members room «at» membership not_membership =>
    api_members.get_member_events_route s req.user room «at» membership
      not_membership
  | Op.JoinedMembers room => api_members.joined_members_route s req.user room
  | Op.InitialSync room limit =>
    api_room.room_initial_sync_route s req.user room limit
  | Op.RoomEvent room event =>
    api_room.get_room_event_route s req.user room event
  | Op.ServerCanSee origin room event =>
    let b ← svc_accessor.server_can_see_event s origin room event
    ok (core.result.Result.Ok (Reply.CanSee b))

    Source: 'src/api_room.rs', lines 121:0-135:1

def api_room.get_room_event_route
  (s : Snapshot) (user : Std.U64) (room : Std.U64) (event_id : Std.U64) :
  Result (core.result.Result Reply Error)
  := do
  let event ← svc_timeline.get_pdu s event_id
  let visible ← svc_accessor.user_can_see_event s user room event_id
  match event with
  | core.result.Result.Ok p =>
    if visible
    then
      let p1 ←
        alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice Pdu) 
          s.pdus p
      let b ← api_message.is_ignored_pdu s p1 user
      if b
      then ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.SenderIgnored)
      else ok (core.result.Result.Ok (Reply.RoomEvent p1.event_id))
    else ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.NotFound)
  | core.result.Result.Err _ => ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.NotFound)

def api_state.get_state_events_route
  (s : Snapshot) (user : Std.U64) (room : Std.U64) :
  Result (core.result.Result Reply Error)
  := do
  let b ← svc_accessor.user_can_see_state_events s user room
  if b
  then
    let r ← svc_accessor.room_state_full_pdus s room
    match r with
    | core.result.Result.Ok v =>
      let events ←
        api_state.get_state_events_route_loop s v (alloc.vec.Vec.new Std.U64)
          0#usize
      ok (core.result.Result.Ok (Reply.State events))
    | core.result.Result.Err e => ok (core.result.Result.Err e)
  else ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.Forbidden)

lean.code:
/-- [tuwunel_kernel::svc_accessor::server_can_see_event]:
    Source: 'src/svc_accessor.rs', lines 262:0-275:1
    Visibility: public -/
def svc_accessor.server_can_see_event
  (s : Snapshot) (origin : Std.U64) (room : Std.U64) (event_id : Std.U64) :
  Result Bool
  := do
  let r ← svc_timeline.pdu_shortstatehash s event_id
  match r with
  | core.result.Result.Ok hash =>
    let hv ← svc_accessor.history_visibility_at s hash
    let members ← svc_cache.room_members s room
    match hv with
    | HistoryVisibility.WorldReadable => ok true
    | HistoryVisibility.Shared => ok true
    | HistoryVisibility.Invited =>
      let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref members
      svc_accessor.any_member_was s hash origin s1 false
    | HistoryVisibility.Joined =>
      let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref members
      svc_accessor.any_member_was s hash origin s1 true
    | HistoryVisibility.Custom _ => ok true
  | core.result.Result.Err _ => ok true

import Spec
import I5hLib
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result tuwunel_kernel tuwunel_kernel.Spec I5hLib

namespace tuwunel_kernel.Solution

lemma resolve_base_event_implies_room_event
    (s : Snapshot) (u room ev : U64) (x : I64 × Usize)
    (h : api_context.resolve_base_event s room ev u false = ok (.Ok x)) :
    api_room.get_room_event_route s u room ev = ok (.Ok (Reply.RoomEvent ev)) := by
  unfold api_context.resolve_base_event at h
  i5h_invert h
  · cases ‹False›
  · unfold api_room.get_room_event_route
    simp_all
    scalar_tac

theorem context_base_served_by_event (s : Snapshot) (u room ev lim : U64) (f : Filter)
    (base : U64) (st en : I64) (before after state : alloc.vec.Vec U64)
    (h : transition s ⟨u, .Context room ev lim f⟩ = ok (.Ok (.Context base st en before after state)))
    (hk : Keys s) :
    transition s ⟨u, .RoomEvent room ev⟩ = ok (.Ok (.RoomEvent ev)) := by
  have _ := hk
  unfold transition at h
  dsimp only at h
  unfold api_context.get_context_route api_context.event_context at h
  obtain ⟨b, hb, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
  split at h
  · obtain ⟨limit1, hlimit1, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
    obtain ⟨r, hr, h⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 h
    cases r with
    | Err e => simp only [ok.injEq, reduceCtorEq] at h
    | Ok x =>
      unfold transition
      dsimp only
      exact resolve_base_event_implies_room_event s u room ev x hr
  · simp only [ok.injEq, reduceCtorEq] at h

end tuwunel_kernel.Solution

theorem context_base_served_by_event (s : Snapshot) (u room ev lim : U64) (f : Filter)
    (base : U64) (st en : I64) (before after state : alloc.vec.Vec U64)
    (h : transition s ⟨u, .Context room ev lim f⟩ = ok (.Ok (.Context base st en before after state)))
    (hk : Keys s) :
    transition s ⟨u, .RoomEvent room ev⟩ = ok (.Ok (.RoomEvent ev)) := by

  unfold transition at h
  unfold api_context.get_context_route at h
